premise: A level 1 adventurer, the weakest in the guild, with a unique skill that lets him keep leveling up without any limit.

draft.premise: A level 1 adventurer, the weakest in the guild, with a unique skill that lets him keep leveling up without any limit.

world.title: Infinite Ascent
world.era: High Medieval fantasy: swords, bows, and a Guild-administered System magic.

extraordinary.reach: Governs all stats, levels, and skills of living beings.
Allows manipulation of physical elements through spells.

rules.text: The System awards experience and levels only to those who defeat monsters or complete Guild-sanctioned trials.
Every person has a natural level cap dictated by their soul's birth potential, which cannot normally be exceeded.
Magic spells can only be cast by those who have unlocked specific elemental classes through the System.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: The dominant species, organized into kingdoms and centered around adventurer guilds.
relations: Struggling constantly against monster tides from the wild lands.

creatures.name: Shadow Wolf
creatures.description: A dark, predatory beast that stalks the forest fringes.

rungs.name: Level 1 (Novice)
rungs.description: Fresh recruits just starting their journey.

rungs.name: Level 5 (Copper)
rungs.description: Experienced fighters capable of clearing minor dens.

rungs.name: Level 10 (Bronze)
rungs.description: Seasoned combatants trusted with village protection.

rungs.name: Level 20 (Silver)
rungs.description: Elite warriors who deal with high-threat monsters.

rungs.name: Level 50 (Gold)
rungs.description: Masters of combat, leading military campaigns.

rungs.name: Level 100 (Legend)
rungs.description: Mythical beings capable of reshaping kingdoms.

travel.description: Foot, horse-drawn carriage, or rare teleportation gates between major capitals.

medicine.healing: Minor potions and low-tier light magic heal cuts and bruises quickly; severed limbs require high-level holy spells.

laws.text: Adventurers shall not use System skills to harm or rob citizens within city walls.

places.name: Oakhaven Region
places.description: A temperate borderland surrounding the town of Oakhaven.

places.name: Oakhaven Town
places.description: A bustling frontier town protected by tall wooden palisades.

places.name: Adventurers' Guild Hall
places.description: A noisy, cavernous hall smelling of ale, roasted meat, and sweat.

places.name: Howling Woods
places.description: A dense, dark forest infested with low-level monsters.

factions.name: The Adventurers' Guild
factions.description: An international organization that issues quests and ranks adventurers based on their strength.

factions.name: The Iron Fangs
factions.description: A local party of Bronze-rank bullies who dominate the low-level quest board in Oakhaven.

npcs.name: Elena
npcs.description: A patient, kind-hearted receptionist who handles low-rank registrations.
npcs.appearance: A young woman with neat brown hair, wearing the blue and white uniform of the Guild.

npcs.name: Karl
npcs.description: An arrogant Bronze-rank warrior who takes pleasure in belittling newcomers.
npcs.appearance: A burly, scarred man wearing cheap steel chest armor, leaning on a heavy iron broadsword.

clocks.name: Pay rent or face eviction
steps: The innkeeper demands 10 copper coins for the weekly rent.
The innkeeper locks your room and warns you have 24 hours left.
You are thrown out onto the streets of Oakhaven.

threads.title: Ascending the Ranks
threads.stakes: Prove you are not the weakest adventurer in Oakhaven.

mysteries.question: How did I obtain a skill that breaks the System's potential limit?
mysteries.answer: The player was born with a fractured soul soul-root that, instead of blocking development, acts as an open vessel that never fills, bypassed only because of a cosmic administrative error in the System's local node.
clues: An ancient text about 'Fractured Souls' in the Guild archive.
An anomalous flicker in the player's status window when leveling up.

known_facts: You are currently the weakest registered adventurer in Oakhaven.
Most people's levels stop growing once they reach their innate cap.
Your unique skill allows you to gain experience and levels infinitely.

opening.situation: You stand before Elena's desk at the Adventurers' Guild Hall, clutching your bronze Level 1 registration tag while Karl laughs loudly behind you.

world.summary: You are a level 1 adventurer, widely mocked as the weakest recruit in Oakhaven. However, you possess a secret unique skill that breaks the System's laws, allowing you to level up without any limit. Now, you must survive your first quests and begin your limitless climb.

character.name: Ethan
character.description: A slender youth with quiet determination, refusing to break under the laughter of stronger men.
character.appearance: Messy dark hair, thin frame, dressed in faded brown leather armor and carrying a slightly rusted shortsword.

skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.notes: Basic swings and parries learned from manual practice.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.notes: A quick step back to avoid wild swings.

traits.name: Indomitable Will
traits.description: Allows you to withstand pain and mockery without backing down.

talents.name: Limitless Ascent
talents.covers: any level or attribute growth under the System.
talents.reason: An anomaly in your soul bypasses all innate potential barriers, allowing infinite progression.

powers.name: Limitless Growth
limits: Requires killing blows or difficult trials to generate experience points.

items.name: Faded Leather Armor
items.description: Thin, worn armor that offers minimal protection.
